title: Model Delivery, Multimodal Pipelines, and Offline Governance Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies model delivery, multimodal pipelines, and offline governance?
options: Version the entire pipeline, verify and activate atomically, retain last known good, minimise modality data, and rehearse failure.
questions.answer: Version the entire pipeline, verify and activate atomically, retain last known good, minimise modality data, and rehearse failure.
questions.explanation: The correct response preserves authority, compatibility, exact artifact evidence, adverse-path behavior, and operational ownership.

questions.prompt: Updating only the model file cannot affect preprocessing, labels, thresholds, or runtime compatibility.
questions.explanation: Replacing the active model file in place can leave a corrupt partial model after process death or storage failure.

questions.prompt: Why retain a last known-good model?
questions.answer: A failed, incompatible, or harmful download can be deactivated without removing the user’s existing offline capability.
questions.explanation: The answer identifies the contract or mechanism that remains valid beyond one implementation demonstration.
